supporting_observations.claim: During the alert window, WS-MFISCHER-01 made repeated outbound TCP connections to the explicit proxy at 10.55.20.30:8080, including at 13:41:02, 13:45:17, 13:50:39, 13:55:12, 14:00:34, 14:05:31, and 14:10:40 UTC.
